attacks.claim: Plugin discovery auto-loads and executes any installed package that declares the `tasq-plugin` keyword, with no allowlist, consent, or trust check. Any transitive dependency, including one pulled in by a compromised upstream, can register code that runs on every `tasq` invocation. The docs tell users to run `tasq lint-staged` in pre-commit hooks and `tasq run` in CI, so this runs in the most privileged contexts.
attacks.evidence: "Any installed package with the `tasq-plugin` keyword is picked up automatically. No more `plugins: [...]` array in `tasq.config.ts`." and "On every invocation ... the CLI walks `node_modules` ... and loads the ones whose `keywords` include `tasq-plugin`." ABSENT: any trust boundary, opt-in allowlist, or statement that loading a plugin does not execute its code.
